_doc: Copy to config/local.json (gitignored). Secrets are REFERENCES resolved by ops/fleet_kit/fleet_secrets.py - never a literal value here. Plan 080: zero config is the intended setup; automation, notification rules and tunables are fixed (a value for one of those here is an incident switch that expires 24 h after Ebonwake first reads it).

bdo._doc: Plan 065. Blank = auto (Steam libraryfolders.vdf -> <library>/steamapps/common/Black Desert Online; Documents known folder -> Black Desert). A path here (or Settings > Game folders) always wins.

overlay._doc: Plan 022. anchor: tl|tr|bl|br|ml|mr or {"x": int, "y": int} (work-area relative); default ml keeps it off the top-right minimap. display: index into the display list, null = auto (primary). scale 0.8-1.6. opacity (panel) 0.5-0.95. Widgets are chosen by context (plan 067).

notify._doc: Plan 080: every notification rule is on while logged in; game-closed quiet and the 15/5/1 ladder govern volume. mute_until: blank = auto (not muted) or an ISO UTC time at most 24 h ahead. silent: no notification sound (default true).

ocr._doc: tesseract: blank = auto (PATH, then the default install dir), else the full path to tesseract.exe.

loop._doc: tools/ew_loop.py tick. inbox_dir / outbox_dir default to <root>/moon_sync_inbox and moon_sync_outbox. max_notes_per_day: kit v8 item 14 cap 6 (may lower, never raise; only ORDER/FIX/RULING-class notes are exempt, order-closing ANSWERs count). Plan 093: each reply is also byte-copied into the destination tree's inbox, re-hashed and logged to ops/loop/control/delivery.jsonl; the inbox comes from dest_inboxes {CODE: dir}, else the fleet roster (roster path, else env FLEET_ROSTER) entry's inbox or root/moon_sync_inbox.

market._doc: Plan 027. Net proceeds after the 35 percent market tax. vp: true while a Value Pack is active (+30 percent of the after-tax amount; an armed Value Pack buff timer wins). fame_pct: the Family Fame sale bonus shown in game, 0-1.5 (percent).

profile._doc: Plan 061. base_url: a self-hosted BDO-REST-API instance (man90/bdo-rest-api, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8001/v1). Blank = off. The public instance is robots-disallowed and is never called; a non-loopback base is used only while its robots.txt allows Ebonwake.
profile._doc_multi_character: false = one character (no Tag partner, no alts): maintenance loss warnings about Tag Characters / alts are suppressed (plan 074, listed under suppressed in GET /api/maint/digest).
